
========================================================================
Ejemplo 1. La planta de alabeo del x500: de dónde sale b
========================================================================
  masa 2.064 kg, peso 20.25 N, empuje por motor en estacionario 5.063 N
  Omega0 = sqrt(m g / (4 kT)) = 769.6 rad/s
  salida de motor en estacionario u0 = (Omega0 - 150)/850 = 0.7289
  dT/dOmega = 2 kT Omega0 = 0.01316 N s/rad;  dT/du = dT/dOmega * 850 = 11.18 N
  par normalizado u: dos motores suben u/sqrt2, dos bajan u/sqrt2; brazo 0.174 m
  par de alabeo por unidad de u: 4 * 0.174 * (1/sqrt2) * 11.18 = 5.504 N m
  b = ese par / Jx = 5.504 / 0.02389 = 230.4 rad/s^2
  saturación a empuje constante: u0 + u/sqrt2 = 1 -> u = 0.3834 -> 88 rad/s^2
  si el asignador baja el colectivo a 0,5: 0,5 + u/sqrt2 = 1 -> u = 0.7071

========================================================================
Ejemplo 2. Forma ideal y forma paralela con las ganancias de PX4
========================================================================
  paralela (MC_ROLLRATE_K = 1): Kp = 0.15, Ki = 0.2 1/s, Kd = 0.003 s
  ideal equivalente: K = Kp = 0.15, Ti = Kp/Ki = 0.750 s, Td = Kd/Kp = 0.0200 s
  error constante 0.2 rad/s: término P = 0.030; el I iguala al P a los t = Ti = 0.75 s (I(t) = Ki e0 t = 0.030)
  instante: omega_sp = 1.0, omega = 0.8 (e = 0.2 rad/s), integral del error 0.1 rad, omega_dot = 5.0 rad/s^2, FF = 0
    P e = 0.030; I int = 0.020; -D omega_dot = -0.015; tau_sp = K (suma) = 0.035
  solo P ante el par de 0,3 N m (centro de masas desplazado 1,5 cm): omega' = b u + 12.56 = 0 en régimen -> u = -0.0545 -> error e = 0.0545/Kp = 0.363 rad/s = 21 °/s; con I, 0

========================================================================
Ejemplo 3. Derivada filtrada y derivative kick
========================================================================
  filtro de la D a 20.0 Hz: omega_d = 125.7 rad/s; ganancia máxima Kd omega_d = 0.377
       1 Hz: |Kd s| =  0.0188, |Kd s/(1+s/wd)| = 0.0188   (P = 0.15)
      10 Hz: |Kd s| =  0.1885, |Kd s/(1+s/wd)| = 0.1686   (P = 0.15)
      20 Hz: |Kd s| =  0.3770, |Kd s/(1+s/wd)| = 0.2666   (P = 0.15)
     100 Hz: |Kd s| =  1.8850, |Kd s/(1+s/wd)| = 0.3697   (P = 0.15)
     400 Hz: |Kd s| =  7.5398, |Kd s/(1+s/wd)| = 0.3765   (P = 0.15)
  escalón de 1 rad/s en la consigna con D sobre el error, lazo a 250 Hz: primer D_k = Kd/(T(1+alpha)) = 0.251 (saturación del par: 0.383)
  escalón de 1 rad/s en la consigna con D sobre el error, lazo a 800 Hz: primer D_k = Kd/(T(1+alpha)) = 0.326 (saturación del par: 0.383)
  continuo: pico Kd omega_d * 1 = 0.377; con D sobre la medida el pico es 0

========================================================================
Ejemplo 4. Discretización: integrador y filtro de la derivada
========================================================================
  250 Hz: T = 4.00 ms, alpha = 1/(omega_d T) = 1.989; 1/(1+alpha) = 0.3345 = AlphaFilter dt/(tau+dt) = 0.3345
  800 Hz: T = 1.25 ms, alpha = 1/(omega_d T) = 6.366; 1/(1+alpha) = 0.1358 = AlphaFilter dt/(tau+dt) = 0.1358
  integrador a 800 Hz con e = 0.2 constante: cada muestra suma Ki T e = 5.00e-05; en 1 s, 0.040
  rampa de la medida a 10 rad/s^2 (800 Hz): D_k = -0.0041 -0.0076 -0.0106 -0.0133 -0.0155 -0.0175 -0.0192 -0.0207 -> tiende a -Kd*10 = -0.030

 [[ 0.9563  0.      0.2924]
 [ 0.      1.      0.    ]
 [-0.2924  0.      0.9563]]

Ejemplo 16. INDI en un paso, eje de alabeo del x500
========================================================================
  par de perturbación 0.3 N m / Jx = 12.56 rad/s^2 (G = b = 230.4 rad/s^2 por unidad de mando)
  instante anterior: u0 = 0.0, omega_dot0 medida = 12.56; consigna nu = 0.0
  u = u0 + (nu - omega_dot0)/G = -0.0545; comprobación: b u + perturbación = 0.00e+00
  si además omega_sp = 1.0, omega = 0.8: nu = K_w e = 9.0 rad/s^2; siguiente u = -0.0545 + (9.0 - 0)/230 = -0.0154

========================================================================
Ejemplo 17. Ala fija: modelo de diseño del alabeo del Aerosonde
========================================================================
  Gamma = Jx Jz - Jxz^2 = 1.4356 kg^2 m^4; Gamma3 = Jz/Gamma = 1.2253, Gamma4 = Jxz/Gamma = 0.0839 1/(kg m^2)
  C_p_p = Gamma3 C_l_p + Gamma4 C_n_p = -0.6191;  C_p_da = Gamma3 C_l_da + Gamma4 C_n_da = 0.2074
  presión dinámica 1/2 rho Va^2 = 396.3 Pa; 1/2 rho Va^2 S b = 631.2 N m
  a_phi1 = -(1/2 rho Va^2 S b) C_p_p b/(2Va) = 22.63 1/s;  a_phi2 = (1/2 rho Va^2 S b) C_p_da = 130.88 1/s^2
  kp = 45°/15° = 3.00; omega_n = sqrt(a2 kp) = 19.82 rad/s = 3.15 Hz; kd = (2 zeta omega_n - a1)/a2 = 0.0412 s
  polos del lazo cerrado s^2 + (a1 + a2 kd) s + a2 kp: [-14.0095+14.0137j -14.0095-14.0137j]; |polo| = 19.82, zeta = 0.707
  sin derivada (kd = 0): zeta = a1/(2 omega_n) = 0.571
  rumbo W =  5: omega_n_chi = 3.963 rad/s (periodo  1.6 s); kp_chi = 2 zeta omega_n V_g/g = 14.281, ki_chi = omega_n^2 V_g/g = 40.026 1/s
  rumbo W = 10: omega_n_chi = 1.982 rad/s (periodo  3.2 s); kp_chi = 2 zeta omega_n V_g/g = 7.140, ki_chi = omega_n^2 V_g/g = 10.006 1/s
  rumbo W = 20: omega_n_chi = 0.991 rad/s (periodo  6.3 s); kp_chi = 2 zeta omega_n V_g/g = 3.570, ki_chi = omega_n^2 V_g/g = 2.502 1/s
  giro coordinado a 25 m/s con 20° de alabeo: chi' = g tan(phi)/V = 0.1428 rad/s (lineal g phi/V = 0.1370); radio V^2/(g tan phi) = 175 m

========================================================================
Ejemplo 18. TECS: energía específica en el Aerosonde (m = 11 kg, V = 25 m/s)
========================================================================
  subir a gamma = 5° sin cambiar V: Es' = V sen gamma = 2.18 m/s; (T - D)/(m g) = sen gamma = 0.0872 -> T - D = 9.4 N
  tirar del mando a 5° sin tocar el motor (T = D): V' = -g sen gamma = -0.855 m/s^2; Es' = 0 y Ls'/V = 2 sen gamma = 0.1743
  energía: 1 m/s de velocidad a 25 m/s vale V dV/g = 2.55 m de altura

Ejemplo 19. Guiado L1: geometría y linealización
========================================================================
  V = 25.0, L1 = 80.0, separación 30.0 m, rumbo paralelo: sen eta = d/L1 = 0.375 -> eta = 22.0°
  a_cmd = 2 V^2/L1 sen eta = 5.86 m/s^2 -> alabeo atan(a/g) = 30.8°
  omega_n = sqrt2 V/L1 = 0.442 rad/s (periodo propio 14.2 s), zeta = 0.707
  aproximación lineal en el instante inicial: eta ~ d/L1 = 0.375 rad frente a 0.384

Ejemplo 20. Fase que cuesta el retardo de una política: Delta phi = omega_c tau
========================================================================
  lazo de rate del x500: f_c = 6.30 Hz, tau = 20 ms -> Delta phi = 45°
  actitud de PX4 (k = 4): f_c = 0.64 Hz, tau = 57 ms -> Delta phi = 13°
  lazo de rate con 57 ms: f_c = 6.30 Hz, tau = 57 ms -> Delta phi = 129°
